title: Mobilization against bill 24.290 and proposed 4x3 work schedule
location: San José; article reports a mobilization but no specific route.
scope: City-level demonstration; national campaign context, attendance scope unknown.
organizer: Movimiento Trabajo Digno and participating left, labor and student organizations
threshold_50_evidence: The opened article reports occurrence and cross-sector involvement but no number of people.

start_date.summary: The opened article dates the mobilization to 8 August.

location.summary: The article identifies San José but does not verify a specific route.

organizer.summary: Article attributes it to the Movimiento Trabajo Digno campaign and participating organizations.

demands.summary: Protest opposed bill 24.290, which would authorize 12-hour workdays.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count or sufficiently clear crowd description to establish 50.

state_target.summary: The campaign sought withdrawal of a bill under consideration in the Legislative Assembly.

notes: An actual mobilization against proposed 12-hour shifts is reported. No size can be inferred from organizational diversity.
open_questions: Was there a count or reliable contemporaneous estimate from another outlet or organizer?
What route and final destination were used?
Did the campaign have an additional demand explicitly directed to the Executive?

title: APSE march from Zapote to Casa Presidencial over education funding and labor claims
location: Zapote, San José, from Iglesia El Centro to Casa Presidencial
scope: March toward national executive; attendance unknown.
participants_original: APSE says regional coordinators, branch presidents and affiliates from across Costa Rica accompanied the march; no simultaneous headcount reported.
threshold_50_evidence: The number of APSE members present at the march is not stated; do not infer threshold from national affiliation or union membership.

start_date.summary: Both APSE and Radio Columbia search report the march on 14 August.

location.summary: APSE describes the march from a church in Zapote to Casa Presidencial.

organizer.summary: APSE leadership organized the action during its general assembly.

demands.summary: Demands include constitutional education allocation, wage increase/arrears and withdrawal of bill 24.786.

participants_original.summary: Only categories of participating union representatives/affiliates are given; no headcount.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No reported number; national affiliation is not a simultaneous attendance count.

state_target.summary: March proceeded to Casa Presidencial with a list of demands for government.

notes: Union and local-radio accounts confirm occurrence and demands, but no crowd size.
open_questions: Were the five listed demands delivered to an official?
Did any action continue after 14 August?

title: TEC students protest transport service at Cartago campus
scope: Campus-level protest; wider scope not established.
participants_original: Search summaries refer to a group of students; no numeric count.
threshold_50_evidence: UCR and CR Hoy search results establish an occurrence but no count or size estimate.

start_date.summary: UCR database and CR Hoy search result date this occurrence to 13 August.

location.summary: Search results place the event at TEC in Cartago.

demands.summary: Students sought a response to deterioration in campus transport.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance figure in returned summaries.

state_target.summary: The demand was directed to TEC leadership, a public autonomous institution; scope and precise remedy need confirmation.

notes: Search-only evidence supports a student action concerning a public university transport service; no body-read source or participant count.
open_questions: Did 50 or more students participate at one time?
What precise transport action did students seek from the rector?
Was the 13 August protest one episode or the opening of a later action?

title: TEC students block campus entrance over transport service
scope: Campus-level action; no other sites established.
participants_original: No count; UCR database describes a group of students and a blockade.
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous headcount in retrieved reports.

start_date.summary: UCR database and CR Hoy search result identify a 21 August action.

demands.summary: Students sought a response from the TEC rector to deterioration in transport services.

state_target.summary: The demand addressed the rector of the public TEC; exact remedy remains open.

notes: This is a separately dated action from the 13 August protest; treat it as a new occurrence unless review finds continuity evidence.
open_questions: How many protesters were present at the blockade?
Was there a follow-up agreement or response?
Did the 13 and 21 August actions form a continuous episode?
